map.📖 查看「填料（碳酸钙/滑石粉）添加 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'Filler (Calcium Carbonate/Talc) Addition'
map.填料加入量 = 绝干浆量 × 加填率；留着填料量 = 加入量 × 70%；成纸灰: Filler addition = oven-dry pulp amount × filling rate; retained filler = addition × 70%; ash content of the sheet = retained amount ÷ (pulp amount + retained amount) × 100%
map.碳酸钙/滑石粉等填料的留着率通常按 70% 估算；据此由加填率推算实际进入成纸的: The retention of fillers such as calcium carbonate or talc is usually estimated at 70%; from the filling rate the filler actually entering the sheet, the ash content and the filler-to-fibre ratio are derived, for cost and quality balance.
map.💡 填料加入量 = 绝干浆量 × 加填率；留着率按 70% 估算；灰分 = 留着: 💡 Filler addition = oven-dry pulp amount × filling rate; retention estimated at 70%; ash = retained amount ÷ (pulp amount + retained amount) × 100%.
map.加填方案设计：按绝干浆量与目标加填率计算填料加入量，并按 70% 留着率估算进入: Filling scheme design: compute the filler addition from the oven-dry pulp amount and the target filling rate, and estimate the filler entering the sheet and the ash content at 70% retention, avoiding ash above the limit that would cause a strength drop.
map.成本与质量平衡：碳酸钙与滑石粉单价不同，用同一加填率下的灰分与填料纤维比对照，判: Cost and quality balance: calcium carbonate and talc have different prices; compare the ash content and filler-to-fibre ratio at the same filling rate to judge whether a cheaper filler can replace part of the expensive one.
map.生产异常排查：成纸灰分实测值明显低于估算值时，通常说明留着率下降（助留剂失效或真: Troubleshooting production deviations: when the measured ash content of the sheet is clearly below the estimate, it usually indicates a drop in retention (retention aid failure or excessive vacuum), which locates the process problem.
map.算例：绝干浆量 1000 kg、加填率 20%: Worked example: oven-dry pulp amount 1000 kg, filling rate 20%
map.填料加入量 = 1000 × 20% = 200.00 kg；按 70% 留着率: Filler addition = 1000 × 20% = 200.00 kg; at 70% retention, retained filler = 140.00 kg; estimated ash content = 140 ÷ (1000 + 140) × 100% = 12.28%; filler/fibre mass ratio = 0.1400; addition as a share of total oven-dry mass = 200 ÷ 1200 × 100% = 16.67%.
map.未加助留剂的常规纸机段填料留着率约 50%–75%，70% 是中间偏保守的经验值: On a conventional paper machine section without retention aid, filler retention is about 50%–75%, so 70% is a moderately conservative empirical value; with a retention aid it can exceed 85%. In practice it should be back-calculated from the measured ash on the machine.
map.灰分越高越好吗？: Is a higher ash content always better?
map.不是。加填能改善不透明度与平滑度并降低成本，但灰分过高会削弱纤维间结合，导致抗张: No. Filling improves opacity and smoothness and lowers cost, but excessive ash weakens fibre bonding and reduces tensile and fold strength; for printing papers the ash is usually kept in the 10%–25% range.

map.注意事项：模型不测量灰分，假设纤维全部留着、无其他无机物；实际灰分须按材料与试验: Note: the model does not measure ash and assumes all fiber is retained with no other inorganic matter; actual ash must be measured by the applicable method.

map.这个结果能直接当灰分用吗？: Can this result be used directly as ash content?
map.不能。它是简化填料质量占比，假设纤维全部留着、无其他无机物、留着填料灼烧后与灰分: No. It is a simplified filler mass share assuming all fiber is retained, no other inorganic matter and retained filler equals ash after ignition; actual ash depends on fiber retention, filler type and ignition conditions and must be measured.
map.不是。70% 只是默认可修改的示例参数，未核实具体纸机、助留剂与浆料条件；请用本: No. 70% is only an editable default, not verified for a specific machine, retention aid or furnish; replace it with measured data from your machine.
